036public class NamelessRock {
037
038        public static String ONESLAUGHT_SENSOR_ARRAY = "$oneslaughtSensorArray";
039        public static String ONESLAUGHT_SENSOR_ARRAY_SYSTEM = "oneslaughtSensorArraySystem";
040        public static String NAMELESS_ROCK_LOCATION_ID = "nameless_rock_location";
041        
042        public void generate(SectorAPI sector) {
043                StarSystemAPI system = sector.createStarSystem("Deep Space");
044                //system.setType(StarSystemType.NEBULA);
045                system.setName("Deep Space"); // to get rid of "Star System" at the end of the name
046                system.setOptionalUniqueId(NAMELESS_ROCK_LOCATION_ID);
047                
048                system.setType(StarSystemType.DEEP_SPACE);
049                system.addTag(Tags.THEME_HIDDEN);
050                system.addTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL);
051                system.addTag(Tags.SYSTEM_ABYSSAL);
052                
053                
054                system.setBackgroundTextureFilename("graphics/backgrounds/background5.jpg");
055
056                Random random = StarSystemGenerator.random;
057                
058                float w = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorWidth");
059                float h = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorHeight");
060                
061                Vector2f systemLoc = new Vector2f();
062                float outsideMapPad = 2500f;
063                float outsideMapRand = 2500f;
064                float r = random.nextFloat();
065                // avoid the actual lower-left corner somewhat, since the gate hauler is there, too, but
066                if (r < 0.5f) { // left
067                        systemLoc.x = -w/2f - outsideMapPad - outsideMapRand * random.nextFloat();
068                        //systemLoc.y = -h/2f - outsideMapPad + (h + outsideMapPad * 2f) * random.nextFloat();
069                        systemLoc.y = -h/2f + (h + outsideMapPad * 1f) * random.nextFloat();
070                } else { //if (r < 0.75f) { // bottom
071                        systemLoc.x = -w/2f + (w + outsideMapPad * 1f) * random.nextFloat();
072                        systemLoc.y = -h/2f - outsideMapPad - outsideMapRand * random.nextFloat();
073                }
074//              else if (r < 0.5f) { // right
075//                      systemLoc.x = w/2f + outsideMapPad + outsideMapRand * random.nextFloat();
076//                      systemLoc.y = -h/2f - outsideMapPad + (h + outsideMapPad * 2f) * random.nextFloat();
077//              } else { // top
078//                      systemLoc.x = -w/2f - outsideMapPad + (w + outsideMapPad * 2f) * random.nextFloat();
079//                      systemLoc.y = h/2f + outsideMapPad + outsideMapRand * random.nextFloat();
080//              }
081                system.getLocation().set(systemLoc.x, systemLoc.y);
082                
083//              Vector2f systemLoc = new Vector2f(3000f, 21000f);
084//              systemLoc = Misc.getPointWithinRadius(systemLoc, 1000f, random);
085//              system.getLocation().set(-w/2f + systemLoc.x, -h/2f + systemLoc.y);
086
087                SectorEntityToken center = system.initNonStarCenter();
088                
089                system.setLightColor(GateHaulerLocation.ABYSS_AMBIENT_LIGHT_COLOR); // light color in entire system, affects all entities
090                center.addTag(Tags.AMBIENT_LS);
091                
092                //String name = Misc.genEntityCatalogId(2700, 11, 7, CatalogEntryType.PLANET);
093                String name = "Nameless Rock";
094                
095                PlanetAPI rock = system.addPlanet("nameless_rock", null, name, Planets.BARREN, 0, 150, 0, 0);
096                rock.setDescriptionIdOverride("barren_deep_space");
097                
098                //rock.setCustomDescriptionId("???");
099                rock.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$namelessRock", true);
100                
101                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.NO_ATMOSPHERE);
102                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.VERY_COLD);
103                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.DARK);
104                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.ORE_RICH);
105                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.RARE_ORE_MODERATE);
106                
107                rock.setOrbit(null);
108                rock.setLocation(0, 0);
109                
110                addOnslaughtMkI(rock);
111
112                system.autogenerateHyperspaceJumpPoints(false, false);
113                
114                AbyssalRogueStellarObjectEPEC.setAbyssalDetectedRanges(system);
115                
116                createSensorArrayInClosestSystem(system);
117        }
118        
119        
120        protected void addOnslaughtMkI(PlanetAPI rock) {
121                PerShipData ship = new PerShipData("onslaught_mk1_Ancient", ShipCondition.WRECKED, 0f);
122                ship.shipName = "Serial #2F38CB017";
123                DerelictShipData params = new DerelictShipData(ship, false);
124                CustomCampaignEntityAPI entity = (CustomCampaignEntityAPI) BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(
125                                                                        rock.getContainingLocation(),
126                                                                        Entities.WRECK, Factions.NEUTRAL, params);
127                //Misc.makeImportant(entity, "onslaughtMkI");
128                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$onslaughtMkI", true);
129                entity.setSensorProfile(1f);
130                entity.setDiscoverable(true);
131                
132                Random random = StarSystemGenerator.random;
133                float orbitRadius = rock.getRadius() + 200f;
134                float orbitDays = orbitRadius / (10f + random.nextFloat() * 5f);
135                entity.setCircularOrbit(rock, random.nextFloat() * 360f, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
136
137                ShipRecoverySpecialData data = new ShipRecoverySpecialData(null);
138                data.notNowOptionExits = true;
139                data.noDescriptionText = true;
140                DerelictShipEntityPlugin dsep = (DerelictShipEntityPlugin) entity.getCustomPlugin();
141                PerShipData copy = (PerShipData) dsep.getData().ship.clone();
142                copy.variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(copy.variantId).clone();
143                copy.variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
144                copy.variant.setHullVariantId(Misc.genUID());
145                copy.variantId = null;
146                copy.variant.addTag(Tags.SHIP_CAN_NOT_SCUTTLE);
147                copy.variant.addTag(Tags.SHIP_UNIQUE_SIGNATURE);
148                
149                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
150                        copy.condition = ShipCondition.PRISTINE; // so it doesn't get any random d-mods
151                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.GLITCHED_SENSORS);
152                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.FAULTY_GRID);
153                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.DEGRADED_ENGINES);
154                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.DEGRADED_DRIVE_FIELD);
155                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.COMP_STRUCTURE);
156                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.COMP_HULL);
157                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.COMP_ARMOR);
158                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.ERRATIC_INJECTOR);
159                        copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.INCREASED_MAINTENANCE);
160                        
161                        data.storyPointRecovery = true;
162                }
163                
164                copy.nameAlwaysKnown = true;
165                //copy.addDmods = false;
166                copy.pruneWeapons = false;
167                
168                // makes it unpilotable by the the player with Neural Link, don't want that 
169//              AICoreOfficerPlugin plugin = Misc.getAICoreOfficerPlugin(Commodities.GAMMA_CORE);
170//              if (plugin != null) {
171//                      copy.captain = plugin.createPerson(Commodities.GAMMA_CORE, Factions.PLAYER, null);
172//                      copy.captain.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.POLARIZED_ARMOR, 2);
173//                      copy.captain.getStats().setLevel(copy.captain.getStats().getLevel() + 1);
174//                      Misc.setUnremovable(copy.captain, true);
175//                      Misc.setKeepOnShipRecovery(copy.captain, true);
176//              }
177                
178                data.addShip(copy);
179                
180                Misc.setSalvageSpecial(entity, data);
181        }
182        
183        protected void createSensorArrayInClosestSystem(StarSystemAPI rockSystem) {
184                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
185                StarSystemAPI closest = null;
186                for (StarSystemAPI curr : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
187                        if (curr == rockSystem) continue;
188                        if (Misc.getAbyssalDepth(curr.getLocation()) > 0f) continue;
189                        if (curr.getType() == StarSystemType.DEEP_SPACE) continue;
190                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.THEME_HIDDEN)) continue;
191                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL)) continue;
192                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.TEMPORARY_LOCATION)) continue;
193                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.SYSTEM_ABYSSAL)) continue;
194                        
195                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(curr.getLocation(), rockSystem.getLocation());
196                        if (dist < minDist) {
197                                closest = curr;
198                                minDist = dist;
199                        }
200                }
201                
202                if (closest == null) return;
203                
204
205                SectorEntityToken sensor = null;
206                for (SectorEntityToken curr: closest.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.SENSOR_ARRAY)) {
207                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.MAKESHIFT)) continue;
208                        sensor = curr;
209                        break;
210                }
211                
212                if (sensor == null) {
213                        LinkedHashMap<LocationType, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<LocationType, Float>();
214                        weights.put(LocationType.STAR_ORBIT, 10f);
215                        weights.put(LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM, 10f);
216                        WeightedRandomPicker<EntityLocation> locs = BaseThemeGenerator.getLocations(null, closest, null, 100f, weights);
217                        EntityLocation loc = locs.pick();
218                        AddedEntity added = BaseThemeGenerator.addNonSalvageEntity(closest,
219                                        loc, Entities.SENSOR_ARRAY, Factions.NEUTRAL);
220                        if (added != null) {
221                                sensor = added.entity;
222                        }
223                }
224
225                // really shouldn't be possible as BaseThemeGenerator.getLocations() is supposed to
226                // always find something if STAR_ORBIT/OUTER_SYSTEM are supplied in the weights
227                if (sensor == null) return;
228                
229                closest.addTag(Tags.GADHO_ARRAY_SYSTEM);
230                sensor.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(ONESLAUGHT_SENSOR_ARRAY, true);
231                Global.getSector().getPersistentData().put(ONESLAUGHT_SENSOR_ARRAY, sensor);
232
233                // to get it:
234                //SectorEntityToken sensor = (SectorEntityToken) Global.getSector().getPersistentData().get(ONESLAUGHT_SENSOR_ARRAY);
235                
236//              system.addTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL);
237//              system.addTag(Tags.SYSTEM_ALREADY_USED_FOR_STORY);              
238        }
239}
